descripcion_capa: vistas creadas por analistas, no oficiales
sql:
SELECT
  e.level_02_description  AS bu,
  t.year,
  t.period                AS mes,
  SUM(f.amount_lc)        AS net_revenue
FROM `ailab-512816.raw.fct_revenue` f
JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_time` t ON t.dimid_time = f.dimid_time
JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_entity` e ON e.dimid_entity = f.dimid_entity
JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_account` a ON a.dimid_account = f.dimid_account_code
WHERE a.level_02 = 'NR'
GROUP BY e.level_02_description, t.year, t.period

descripcion_capa: vistas creadas por analistas, no oficiales
sql:
SELECT
  a.dimid_account_nk             AS account_id,
  a.account_description,
  f.dimid_account_code,
  t.period                       AS month,
  t.year,
  f.dimid_time,
  s.dimid_scenario_code_nk       AS scenario_id,
  s.scenario_description,
  f.dimid_scenario_code,
  e.dimid_entity_nk              AS entity_id,
  e.entity_description,
  f.dimid_entity,
  p.dimid_product_sku_nk         AS sku_id,
  p.sku_desc,
  f.dimid_product_sku,
  c.dimid_customer_id_nk         AS customer_id,
  c.customer_description,
  f.dimid_customer_id,
  ch.dimid_channel_code_nk       AS channel_id,
  ch.description                 AS channel_description,
  f.dimid_channel_code           AS dimid_channel_id,
  au.dimid_audit_id_nk           AS audit_id,
  au.audit_description,
  f.dimid_audit_id,
  d.UOM                          AS uom,
  f.amount_lc, f.amount_rc, f.amount_ac, f.amount_py,
  f.amount_cf, f.amount_pf, f.amount_mfjun, f.amount_mfsep,
  f.Area                         AS area,
  'MV2026-06'                    AS snapshot_version,
  '2026-06'                      AS snapshot_cycle,
  DATE '2026-07-06'              AS snapshot_date
FROM `ailab-512816.raw.fct_revenue` f
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_account` a  ON a.dimid_account = f.dimid_account_code
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_time` t  ON t.dimid_time = f.dimid_time
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_scenario` s  ON s.dimid_scenario_code = f.dimid_scenario_code
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_entity` e  ON e.dimid_entity = f.dimid_entity
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_product_hierarchy` p  ON p.dimid_product_sku = f.dimid_product_sku
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_customer` c  ON c.dimid_customer_id = f.dimid_customer_id
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_channel` ch ON ch.dimid_channel_code = f.dimid_channel_code
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_audit_trail` au ON au.dimid_audit_id = f.dimid_audit_id
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_document` d  ON d.dimid_document = f.dimid_document

descripcion_capa: vistas creadas por analistas, no oficiales
sql:
SELECT
  t.year,
  t.period                AS mes,
  SUM(f.amount_lc)        AS venta_neta_pen
FROM `ailab-512816.raw.fct_revenue` f
JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_time` t ON t.dimid_time = f.dimid_time
JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_entity` e ON e.dimid_entity = f.dimid_entity
JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_account` a ON a.dimid_account = f.dimid_account_code
WHERE e.dimid_entity_nk = 'PE01'
  AND f.dimid_scenario_code = 1
  AND a.level_02 = 'NR'
GROUP BY t.year, t.period

SELECT
  f.bq_ingest_timestamp           AS bq_ingest_date,
  f.uuid,
  a.dimid_account_nk              AS account,
  s.dimid_scenario_code_nk        AS version,
  CAST(f.dimid_time AS STRING)    AS `date`,
  e.dimid_entity_nk               AS entity,
  p.dimid_product_sku_nk          AS product,
  c.dimid_customer_id_nk          AS customer,
  ch.dimid_channel_code_nk        AS channel,
  au.dimid_audit_id_nk            AS audit_trail,
  pr.dimid_prm_nprm_id_nk         AS prm,
  d.UOM                           AS uom,
  b.dimid_base_id_nk              AS base,
  f.amount_lc, f.amount_rc, f.amount_ac, f.amount_py,
  f.amount_cf, f.amount_pf, f.amount_mfjun, f.amount_mfsep,
  f.source_system
FROM `ailab-512816.raw.fct_revenue` f
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_account` a  ON a.dimid_account = f.dimid_account_code
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_scenario` s  ON s.dimid_scenario_code = f.dimid_scenario_code
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_entity` e  ON e.dimid_entity = f.dimid_entity
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_product_hierarchy` p  ON p.dimid_product_sku = f.dimid_product_sku
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_customer` c  ON c.dimid_customer_id = f.dimid_customer_id
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_channel` ch ON ch.dimid_channel_code = f.dimid_channel_code
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_audit_trail` au ON au.dimid_audit_id = f.dimid_audit_id
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_promo` pr ON pr.dimid_prm_nprm_id = f.dimid_prm_nprm_id
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_document` d  ON d.dimid_document = f.dimid_document
LEFT JOIN `ailab-512816.raw.dim_base` b  ON b.dimid_base_id = f.dimid_base_id
